description: urem by 48 kept although only the low 4 bits are used
still_missed_on: clang trunk (godbolt, -march=skylake), 2026-10-27: missed in the IR, but llc recovers it
notes: C translated from the issue's urem_low_bits reproducer. The miss is real in the IR, but llc already recovers it: the issue's form `%2 = and i32 %0, 15` + `ret i32 %2` (no urem by 48) is proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 and gives the same llvm-mca cycles on Skylake as the source (measured by Benoit with the reference toolchain, 2026-10-28). No assembly gain, so it is an A entry (moved from B, 2026-10-29).
